event_records.description: Kwame decides to request the sponsorship letter from the HR team.

kwame.name: Kwame
kwame.persona_brief:
You are Kwame.
Kwame needs a sponsorship letter from his employer's HR team for his visa renewal. He has a visa-renewal appointment on November 9th. He is aware of the deadline and wants the letter issued before then.

hr_team.name: HR Team
hr_team.persona_brief:
You are HR Team.
The HR team handles employment-related documentation, including sponsorship letters. They have received or may receive requests from employees. They have their own processes and priorities.

resolution.question: Will Kwame get his employer's HR team to issue the sponsorship letter he needs before his visa-renewal appointment on the 9th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the HR team issued the sponsorship letter to Kwame before 2026-11-09T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
